hints.title: Token Extraction
hints.text: Extract all contiguous alphanumeric word tokens from the caption string.

hints.title: Casing Standardization
hints.text: Capitalize the leading character of each token and convert following characters to lowercase.

hints.title: Prefix and Length Truncation
hints.text: Concatenate the capitalized tokens prefixed with a hash symbol and truncate to 100 characters.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import re

class Solution:
    def generateTag(self, caption: str) -> str:
        words = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', caption)
        if not words:
            return ""
        capitalized = [w.capitalize() for w in words]
        tag = "#" + "".join(capitalized)
        return tag[:100]
```
